feed-doomed.desc: adds a stone to an own group that is dead at game end

missed-save.desc: own group in atari, KataGo saves it, ArduGo plays elsewhere

missed-capture.desc: enemy group in atari, KataGo takes it, ArduGo plays elsewhere

missed-attack.desc: enemy group at 2 libs, KataGo presses it, ArduGo plays elsewhere

ignored-atari.desc: own group in atari, KataGo addresses it, ArduGo does neither

captured-soon.desc: the played stone is gone within 4 plies

self-atari.desc: played stone's chain ends with exactly 1 liberty

feed-weak.desc: played stone's chain ends with exactly 2 liberties

connect-miss.desc: KataGo's move connects 2+ own chains, ArduGo plays elsewhere

cut-miss.desc: KataGo's move cuts/wedges 2+ enemy chains, ArduGo plays elsewhere

crawl.desc: plays line 1-2 while KataGo plays line 3+ (low crawl)

edge2.desc: KataGo plays line 2, ArduGo plays line 3+ (edge blindness)

edge1.desc: KataGo plays line 1, ArduGo plays line 3+

local.desc: played adjacent to KataGo's point (right area, wrong point)

tenuki.desc: abandons the hot area KataGo stays in

eye-fill.desc: fills a point whose neighbors are all own stones

own-territory.desc: plays inside a region bordered only by own stones

game-losing.desc: this single move crosses the game from won to lost
